description: Published openings on one company's public Recruitee careers site (pass its subdomain, e.g. bunq for bunq.recruitee.com). Title, department, city, country, employment type, remote flag, publish time, apply link, and salary when the company publishes it. One company per call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
